events.title: Thank you for 100,000 Wishlists!
events.summary: Hamsteria has been wishlisted over 100,000 times! And since the demo came out in may, over 300,000 of you have played it on steam from all over the world! I still can't believe that's true.For celebration, I added a section in the game where you need to crowd surf over 10,000 hamsters at a rave. I just wanted to thank all of you who've played the demo and wishlisted the full game. I'm still not ready to show the whole thing off publicly yet, but I am getting close finishing all of the challenges

events.title: Hamsteria Fully Supports Steamdeck!
events.summary: Hamsteria fully supports Steamdeck with a native Linux build! Including online cross play with Windows users!This isn't new, it always did, but now there's a post about it! Recommended Settings: For 90FPS, I recommend running with shadows on "Low", Anti Aliasing OFF, and 0.75 resolution scale.For 60FPS, you can run the game up to "Medium" shadows, MSAA2x, and 1.0 resolution scale.

events.title: Minor Updates to the Demo.
events.summary: Fixed some problems with first launch audio. The music will delay playing for a couple of frames now to prevent destroying eardrums. Finally fixed the see saw section. The physics should no longer have the blue wheel pulling ahead anymore. Fixed some crashing on first launch. This was due to some systems getting overloaded with too much shader compilation on the first frame. The game will now attempt to precompile most materials before launching the game.Updated our GodotSteam version, hopefully

events.summary: Thank you, thank you, THANK YOU! I never expected such a response, and I'm so grateful for all of your love and support. We've had over 22,000 players for the demo and over 9,000 players on the playtest. Thank you for taking the time to play my game, it means so much to me. Now, for the updates. events.title: Playtest is LIVE!
events.summary: The Hamsteria Playtest is LIVE RIGHT NOW! It will be available until May 14th. Grab a friend and see if you can escape to the top! The playtest is the entire demo level, but be aware this is still an early build. The purpose of the playtest is to find and fix any networking issues. If you find any, please submit feedback with the button at the top left of the pause screen.
